title: Chicken Empanadas
description: A flavorful and crispy empanada filled with seasoned chicken. Perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into small pieces and season with taco seasoning.
Roll out the empanada dough and use a cookie cutter to create circles.
Place a spoonful of the seasoned chicken in the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges with water and fold the dough in half to form a triangle.
Press the edges together with a fork to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops with corn oil and beaten egg.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving.
